notes: A superpower game whose powers land on other players is Action - the author confirmed players use powers on each other - and Simulation is named second because the unanchored traffic cars and loose street elements are a physics playground, which is the one thing only Simulation's physics-rig can express. Open World Action is the closest preset and I kept both its options, but swapped its arena-stacked shape for traversal-city, which describes the author's compact 3-by-3 vertical block map better: rooftops, ledges, grindable neon pipes between buildings, streets below as fallback. Both shapes route P2 so the swap costs nothing, and the wall-running up skyscrapers and elevated pipes genuinely overhang, so the P2 is earned rather than assumed. With no user to ask I honoured the author's refusal of NPC enemies and objectives - no spawner-npc, no capture or winner zone, the space just has to survive being fought across - and added settlement-density for the stated dense 3-by-3 blocks; the neon billboards, rain and reflective surfaces match no option and carry as theme.
